comments.default_start_date: Fixed start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used when use_start_of_year is false
comments.default_days_back: Number of days back from today for new installations (ignored if use_start_of_year is true)
comments.full_refresh_days_back: Number of days back for full refresh operations
comments.use_start_of_year: If true, defaults to January 1st of current year for new installations
comments.incremental_buffer_days: Number of days to go back from last order date for incremental updates
comments.price_refresh_interval_seconds: How often (seconds) to refresh option mark prices during market hours
comments.greeks_refresh_interval_seconds: How often (seconds) to refresh Greeks/IV (slower-changing data)
comments.reconciliation_interval_seconds: How often (seconds) to reload positions from Robinhood during market hours
comments.reconciliation_interval_after_hours_seco: How often (seconds) to reload positions after hours
comments.order_fill_check_interval_seconds: How often (seconds) to check pending order fill status
